Bot Registration Prevention

We tested whether a model could spot automated registrations before giving it any say in who could sign up.

evoke · 2025

The problem

Automated accounts were using stolen or synthetic identities to abuse bonuses. We wanted to catch that activity without making registration harder for legitimate customers.

The decision

We designed the first phase as a parallel evaluation. The model ran alongside sign-up and stored its outputs in Snowflake. Those outputs did not change what customers experienced. We could then assess the results before deciding whether the model should influence registration.

What we looked for

I focused on what the model would need to prove before it could affect sign-up: a useful signal, a fast response and a registration flow that could keep running if the model failed. The evaluation gave the team scores to review in Snowflake while customers continued through the existing sign-up flow.
